info.title: Burq Web API

get.summary:
Authorization endpoint. Sends the user to the consent screen when no consent session
exists, and otherwise issues the authorization code.

200.description: A redirect to the consent page, or the authorization response.

post.summary:
Authorization endpoint. Sends the user to the consent screen when no consent session
exists, and otherwise issues the authorization code.

200.description: A redirect to the consent page, or the authorization response.

post.summary: Token endpoint. Exchanges an authorization code, or a refresh token, for an access token.
Registers a client and returns its assigned identifier.

get.summary:
Describes the pending authorization request so the consent screen can show who is asking
and for what.
get.description:
Everything shown on the consent screen is resolved here rather than parsed out of the
browser's address bar: the client name comes from the client record, and the redirect URI
is re-checked against that record. A caller cannot therefore pair a trusted client's name
with a redirect URI belonging to someone else.

parameters.name: returnUrl
parameters.description:
The authorization request the user was redirected away from, exactly as the authorization
endpoint handed it to the consent page.

200.description: The client, redirect target and requested scopes.

could be brute-forced by anyone who knows the user's e-mail address.

scope.description: Gets or sets the space-separated scopes the client may request.

ClientRegistrationError.description: A client registration error, as defined by RFC 7591.

error.description: Gets or sets the error code.

error_description.description: Gets or sets the human-readable description.

OAuthConsentRequestDetails.description: What the consent screen shows about a pending authorization request.

clientId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the client requesting access.

clientName.description: Gets or sets the display name of the client, falling back to its identifier.

redirectUri.description: Gets or sets the redirect URI the authorization code would be sent to.

redirectHost.description: Gets or sets the host component of RedirectUri.

isLoopbackRedirect.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the redirect URI points at the local machine.

scopes.description: Gets or sets the scopes the client asked for, restricted to the ones this server knows.

OAuthConsentRequest.description: What the user approved on the consent screen.

scopes.description: Gets or sets the scopes the user approved.

ProtectedResourceMetadata.description: Protected resource metadata, as defined by RFC 9728.

resource.description: Gets or sets the resource identifier this document describes.

authorization_servers.description: Gets or sets the authorization servers able to issue tokens for the resource.

scopes_supported.description: Gets or sets the scopes the resource understands.

bearer_methods_supported.description: Gets or sets the ways a token may be presented.

JWT.description: Type into the textbox: Bearer {your JWT token}.
JWT.name: Authorization
